strengths: Existing values and optional profile details are visible together; desktop summary provides a cross-check.

issues.observation: Unit is a required select showing ‘Select a unit’ while the same form summary says ‘$25/gram’ and ‘240 gram’. The screen does not clearly indicate the current unit.
issues.recommendation: Normalize existing units to the available options and show the selected value. Use ‘g’ consistently in summary after a labeled ‘Unit’ control; verify unchanged edits preserve the unit.

issues.observation: The five-step new-listing guide and creation-oriented sentences remain on Edit Product. Mobile reaches3982px; the summary repeats five values in separate cards. Desktop main form occupies a narrow column with a large empty right side below the sticky summary.
issues.recommendation: For edit mode use ‘Edit product’ plus compact section links, remove the creation guide, and use ‘Stock’ rather than ‘Initial Inventory Quantity’. Keep one ‘Save changes’ label across sticky and standard actions. Compact the summary into rows; give editable fields more desktop width.

issues.observation: Batch area has ‘No batches available yet…’, a ‘View batch details’ link, and ‘Link to a harvest batch for lab results’ together even though no batch is selected.
issues.recommendation: Use ‘No batches for this strain’ beside a ‘New batch’ action; hide ‘View batch details’ until a batch is selected. Remove the extra linkage explanation.

limits: Viewed existing record only; no field or data changed. Gray thumbnail may be synthetic fixture imagery and is not treated as a production defect.

pass2.notes: Fresh desktop/mobile revisits confirm the required Unit select displays Select a unit while the summary shows $25/gram and 240 gram. The unlinked batch still presents View batch details. New-listing guidance and repeated save labels remain in edit mode; no fields were changed and no save attempted. Sample-data limitations apply to the unit/batch mismatch.
